cita: At 2023-11-07 03:00 (UTC) , Binance will delist all existing MC spot trading pairs (i.e., MC/BTC and MC/USDT) and cancel all pending MC spot trade orders.
At 2024-02-26 03:00 (UTC) , Binance will delist all existing PLA spot trading pairs (i.e., PLA/BTC and PLA/USDT) and cancel all pending PLA spot trade orders.

At 2024-09-10 03:00 (UTC) , Binance will delist and cease trading on all spot trading pairs for MATIC. The exact trading pairs being removed are: MATIC/BNB, MATIC/BRL, MATIC/BTC, MATIC/ETH, MATIC/EUR, MATIC/FDUSD, MATIC/JPY, MATIC/TRY, MATIC/USDC, and MATIC/USDT.
At 2023-07-17 03:00 (UTC) , Binance will suspend and delist all existing QUICK spot trading pairs (i.e., QUICK/BTC, QUICK/BUSD and QUICK/USDT) and cancel all pending QUICK spot trade orders.
At 2024-03-20 03:00 (UTC) , Binance will delist all existing STRAX spot trading pairs (i.e., STRAX/BTC, STRAX/USDT and STRAX/TRY) and cancel all pending STRAX spot trade orders.
